facts.fact: The Secretary General of the Ministry of Territorial Administration and Mobility, chairing the SNEC steering committee on 19 June 2025, reported for 2024 the deployment of the software for systematic declaration of civil-status events in 20 main centres and 96 secondary centres; no total number of centres is given.
facts.system: solution informatique de déclaration systématique des faits d'Etat civil

facts.fact: The SNEC steering committee, chaired by the Secretary General of the Ministry of Territorial Administration and Mobility, follows the action plan under which the declaration software was deployed, and is the joint decision body of the government and its technical and financial partners, per Sidwaya's report of its 19 June 2025 session.
facts.system: solution informatique de déclaration systématique des faits d'Etat civil

facts.fact: The Stratégie nationale de l'Etat civil 2023-2027 and its rolling action plan 2023-2025 were adopted by joint order n°2024-0039/MATDS/MEFP of 25 January 2024, with a vision of a modern and secure civil status favouring systematic registration by 2027; the deployment of the declaration software is reported among its 2024 results.
facts.system: solution informatique de déclaration systématique des faits d'Etat civil

facts.fact: The committee's chair reported that the SNEC was 68.54% financed in 2024, of which 2.52% from the state budget, 33.46% from local authorities and 64.01% from technical and financial partners, with financial execution of 74.33% and physical execution of 64.11%; the figures are for the strategy as a whole, not the software alone.
facts.system: solution informatique de déclaration systématique des faits d'Etat civil
